## 1. Blunt verdict
Real, correctly-named fuzz-corpus member. Byte-verified: identical to canonical `out3.srt`
except ONE byte — offset 72, `0x6f` ('o' of "one") → `0x90`, i.e. XOR 0xFF — exactly what the
name `xff3_072` (xor-0xFF, seed 3 = out3, offset 072) promises. Creates a lone non-UTF-8
`0x90` inside cue text, exercising the SRT encoding-damage path. The parent out3.srt is the
fixture the canonical differential claims as ffmpeg output (provenance of the PARENT is
UNVERIFIED — see srt_canonical_differential.rs audit F-001).
